title: lilium bulbiferum var. croceum
intro: Lilium bulbiferum var. croceum, commonly known as the Burnt-orange lily or the Orange lily, is a subspecies of the Burnt-orange lily plant, native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lilium bulbiferum var. croceum include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems, due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to its medicinal properties, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a valuable plant for therapeutic purposes.
